name.expression: sources['database'] != null ? sources['database'].name : (sources['crm'] != null ? sources['crm'].name : sources['analytics'].name)

age.expression: list = []; foreach (v : sources.values()) { if (v != null && v.age != null) list.add(v.age); } return java.util.Collections.max(list);

email.expression: sources['database'] != null ? sources['database'].email : (sources['crm'] != null ? sources['crm'].email : sources['analytics'].email)

phone.expression: sources['analytics'] != null ? sources['analytics'].phone : (sources['crm'] != null ? sources['crm'].phone : sources['database'].phone)
